raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-17, and 345 txn_ids appear twice. The cast fails on the epoch strings, and the duplicates would double-count gold totals if the cast were fixed alone.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
